name: Borys Budka - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation on amending Council Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 of 13 July 2021 on establishing the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking and repealing Regulation (EU) 2018/1488
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to expand the European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking, the body that runs Europe's supercomputers, so it can build and run large new "AI Gigafactories" — big centres with over 100,000 advanced AI processors for developing and training very large AI models. It also adds a new pillar for quantum technologies, with money set aside for quantum research. Parliament approves the Commission's proposal with changes, including extra funding and rules on who can use these centres.

- New AI Gigafactories get EU money for up to 17% of computing equipment costs, with matched national funding.
- Small companies, researchers and public bodies get free or priority access to these AI computing centres.
- Parliament's text now goes back to the Council of Ministers, which decides whether to accept the changes.
